title: Volcano Engine Announces Full Availability of Seedance 2.5 4K API, Supporting 10-bit Color Depth and Sample Mode

content_html:
On November 16, ByteDance's Volcano Engine announced that the API for the Seedance 2.5 4K video generation model is now fully open. Starting today, developers and enterprise customers can call the model directly through the API, bringing 4K-level video generation capabilities into a stage of large-scale access.

It is reported that Volcano Engine officially released Seedance 2.5 4K on October 23. According to the company, the model has undergone specialized training, giving it a stronger grasp of facial expressions, subtle movements, and visual details, making it the most capable version in the Seedance 2.5 generation.

On the feature side, Seedance 2.5 4K supports a Draft (sample) mode. End users can first quickly validate storyboards and repeatedly refine shots with 480P drafts, then generate the final 4K video once the result is confirmed. This mode lets the 480P stage handle creative exploration at lower cost while the 4K stage focuses on delivering final image quality, helping reduce trial-and-error costs and improve production efficiency.

In terms of image quality, the model presents textures, contours, and details more fully, making the overall image clearer. With 10-bit color depth, it also delivers richer color gradations and smoother gradient transitions, and the overall quality can meet big-screen presentation requirements.

As video generation models shift from simply pursuing generation quality to balancing image quality, cost, and workflow compatibility, the full opening of the API will further lower the barrier to entry for enterprises and developers, and may drive the adoption of 4K video generation in content production scenarios such as film and television and advertising.
